title: The Fekete-Szegö problem for starlike mappings of order $α$ and quasi-convex mappings of type $B$ in the unit balls of complex Banach spaces
summary: We establish sharp estimates for the generalized Zalcman functional corresponding to the index $n=2$ for normalized starlike mappings of order $α$ and normalized quasi-convex mappings of type $B$ in the unit ball of a complex Banach space and on the unit polydisk in $\mathbb{C}^n$. We also derive sharp Fekete-Szegö inequalities for normalized starlike mappings of order $α$ and normalized quasi-convex mappings of type $B$ in the unit ball of a complex Banach space.
